Suites.Disk Lifecycle: Cross-process: reconciliation lists the shared system temp directory and deletes entries with Armada test prefixes past the retention window, which can include files another test process owns.
Suites.Dispatch Assignment State: Wall-clock bound: asserts an operation finishes in under 500 ms.
Suites.Mission Status Transitions: Wall-clock bound: asserts a cancelled mission's definition-of-done gate stops in under 10 s and frees the process-wide host command slot in under 2 s.
Suites.Harbor Runner Enrollment Service: Wall-clock bound: asserts a slow owner lookup returns control to the caller in under 1 s and a lookup past its bound is refused in under 3 s.
Suites.Captain Account Launch: Wall-clock bound: asserts a hanging login probe is not awaited (under 500 ms); also sets ARMADA_TEST_OPENCODE, ARMADA_TEST_CURSOR_AGENT and a provider key variable.
Suites.Autonomous Objective Scheduler: Wall-clock bound: asserts a sweep completes in under 2 s with a 40 ms per-sweep budget.
Suites.Long Running Job Service: Starts an in-process server on ports found by binding port 0.
Suites.Admiral Server Stop: Starts in-process servers on ports found by binding port 0.
Suites.Loopback Ports: Starts in-process servers on ports found by binding port 0, and holds a loopback port to make one start lose it.
Suites.Objective Dispatch Attempts: Wall-clock bound: asserts a contended admission returns in under 3 s; also starts an in-process server on ports found by binding port 0.
Suites.Dispatch Code Context Bounded: Wall-clock bound: asserts dispatch returns in under 5 s when code context stalls.
Suites.Dispatch Fail Fast: Wall-clock bound: asserts dispatch fails in under 15 s; also sets the git and code-context timeout environment variables.
Suites.PostgreSQL UTC Reads: Process-global: sets TZ and clears the cached time zone data.
Suites.Captain Update Validation: Process-global: sets PATH and the cursor shim environment variables.
Suites.Agent Lifecycle Handler: Process-global: sets PATH and the cursor shim environment variables, subscribes to TaskScheduler.UnobservedTaskException and registers synthetic processes in the static process supervisor.
Suites.Captain Tool Service Discovery: Process-global: points HOME at a sentinel profile directory.
Suites.Claude Code Provider Routing: Process-global: sets and asserts on provider key environment variables a child process inherits.
Suites.Code Context Timeouts: Process-global: sets the code-context timeout environment variable.
Suites.MCP Code Index Tools: Process-global: sets the code-context timeout environment variable.
Suites.Self Deploy Build Runner: Process-global: sets arbitrary environment variables through a scoped helper.
Suites.Captain Runtime Tool Catalog HTTP Probe: Process-global: puts a fake mux CLI first on PATH.
Suites.Self Deploy Service: Process-global: sets the self-deploy rehearsal gate and hold environment variables.
Suites.Typed Decision Key: Starts an in-process server on ports found by binding port 0; changes provider key environment variables.
Suites.TypeSafe Decision Client: Process-global: clears the decision service API key environment variable.
Suites.Workflow Profile and Check Run Services: Process-global: sets build, deploy and AWS environment variables.
Suites.Private Storage Backend: Process-global: replaces the static private file backend.
Suites.Dashboard Static Files: Process-global: sets the static file handler's external path.
Suites.Captain Stall Decision: Process-global: registers a synthetic process in the static process supervisor.
Suites.MCP Context Tools: Process-global: resets the static tool budget.
Suites.MCP Typed Decision Tools: Process-global: resets the static tool budget.
